={{ {model: "llama3.2:latest", stream:false, format:"json", messages:[{role:"system",content:"You are the intent router for EduConnect LMS. Return ONLY JSON with one field: intent. Allowed values: greeting, attendance, fees, quiz, support.

Rules:
- greeting: for hi, hello, hey, good morning, thanks, bye, or any casual non-LMS message
- attendance: for questions about present, absent, attendance percentage, classes attended
- fees: for questions about fee balance, payment, amount due, pending fees, transactions
- quiz: for practice questions, test me, generate quiz, study material requests
- support: for complaints, bugs, help requests, account issues, or anything else LMS-related

Return ONLY the JSON. Example: {\"intent\":\"fees\"}"},{role:"user",content:$json.messageText}] } }}

If the user asks to mark/check-in, explain that the current LMS attendance API is teacher-controlled and cannot safely self-mark a student via Telegram. Keep the reply concise and in the user's language."},{role:"user",content:$json.messageText+"

parameters.content:
## EduConnect LMS Telegram Architecture (Fixed)
Telegram -> Normalize -> Identity Link -> Route Identity (3-way)
  -> skipLookup (cached): Build Session Context -> Intent Router -> Specialist
  -> needsPhone: Ask for Mobile
  -> else (has phone): Lookup -> Store -> Student Found?
     -> Found + linking msg: Send Link Confirmed
     -> Found + regular msg: Build Session Context -> Intent Router
     -> Not Found: Send error
All Telegram replies use PLAIN TEXT (no Markdown) to prevent silent drops.
